description: Source code for a memory profiler in C, which tracks memory allocations, deallocations, and backtraces, and outputs memory usage reports.

classes.name: profiler_block
classes.description: Represents a memory allocation block with address, size, and backtrace information.

classes.name: profiler_stackframe
classes.description: Represents a stack frame in the backtrace with address, size, symbol, and hierarchical links.

methods.name: profiler_free
methods.description: Frees a memory block and updates the hashtable.

methods.name: profiler_hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for a given memory address.

methods.name: profiler_block_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new profiler_block.

methods.name: profiler_block_free
methods.description: Adds a profiler_block to the free list.

methods.name: profiler_try_malloc
methods.description: Attempts to allocate memory and insert into hashtable.

methods.name: profiler_try_realloc
methods.description: Attempts to reallocate memory and update hashtable.

methods.name: profiler_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory and inserts into hashtable.

methods.name: profiler_write
methods.description: Writes a string to the profiler output file descriptor.

methods.name: li_profiler_enable
methods.description: Enables the profiler, sets output, and hooks memory functions.

methods.name: li_profiler_finish
methods.description: Cleans up and frees all profiler data.

methods.name: li_profiler_dump
methods.description: Outputs a memory usage report with backtrace analysis.

methods.name: li_profiler_hashtable_insert
methods.description: Inserts a memory block into the hashtable with backtrace.

methods.name: li_profiler_hashtable_remove
methods.description: Removes a memory block from the hashtable.
